Agent Tooling Resource Index

This index explains how the editorial team evaluates local Agent tools before adding them to an internal skills catalog.

Each recommendation must include a reproducible command, a bounded network behavior note, and a rollback path.

Use the catalog entry only after the offline checks pass and the maintainer has reviewed the generated Markdown.
